LanguageData.AdRef_Gun_ChargeAssault.label: Charge Assault Rifle
LanguageData.AdRef_Gun_ChargeAssault.description: An ancient assault rifle converted into an energy weapon. The ammunition has been replaced with a self-charging bacertia battery and the structure has been heavily reinforced. Greatly increased damage and accuracy. Less range and burst count, but fires very quickly.
LanguageData.AdRef_Gun_ChargePistol.label: Charge Pistol
LanguageData.AdRef_Gun_ChargePistol.description: An ancient pistol converted into an energy weapon. The ammunition has been replaced with a self-charging bacteria battery and the barrel has been reinforced. It's still a short range weapon, but deadlier.
LanguageData.AdRef_Gun_ChargeSniper.label: Charge Sniper Rifle
LanguageData.AdRef_Gun_ChargeSniper.description: An ancient rifle converted into an energy weapon. The cartridge chamber has been replaced with a self-charging bacteria battery and the scope has been greatly improved. Very good range, Good power, low rate of fire.
